newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - Alcatel surges in New York.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - Alcatel surges in New York.

text.p: Shares in French electrical engineering company Alcatel Alsthom Cie Generale d'Electricite' surged on Thursday, highlighting trade in American Depositary Receipts and foreign stocks.

Alcatel rose 2-5/8 to 19, close to a 12-month high, after reporting a strong turnaround in 1996. Volume was very heavy at almost 700,000 shares traded by midday, more than three times the average daily volume.
Investors have been "waiting for 18 months for this company to perform and now it's profitable on the telecommunications side," a trader said.

Doncasters Plc, a British subsidiary of Canada's Inco Ltd, jumped 3-1/4 to 19-3/4 at the start of its initial public offering public offering. Shares in the specialty parts maker were second on the most-active list, with 4.6 million traded by midday.
Shares in Gucci Group NV rose 2-3/8 to 67-1/4 after CS First Boston raised its rating on the stock to buy from strong buy.
Among Latin American shares, bellwether Telefonos de Mexico rose 1/4 to 37-1/4.
Advancers led decliners 248 to 226 among 807 ADRs. Volume was 39 million shares.
